summary: Babylon and Chaldea will be destroyed for their iniquities—No one will save them.
meta_description: Babylon and Chaldea will be destroyed for their iniquities—No one will save them.

footnotes.note1_b: IE Babylon was to be overthrown; this prophecy was fulfilled by Cyrus, 539 B.C.
footnotes.note1_c: HEB virgin daughter; i.e., the heretofore unconquered Babylonian empire.
footnotes.note2_b: IE on the way to exile.
footnotes.note3_a: IE I will not negotiate or compromise in this matter.
footnotes.note5_a: IE you are going into exile.
footnotes.note6_a: IE Israel’s Babylonian captivity is predicted.
footnotes.note8_b: IE Babylon will be depopulated and its king will be destroyed.
